the author's own proof environment immediately following the thm: Left-to-right: a well-ordering of the union of A yields a choice function taking least members. Right-to-left: transfinite recursion on a choice function for the nonempty subsets of A builds an injective enumeration of A; Hartogs' lemma shows the recursion must stop, so A is bijective with an ordinal and inherits a well-ordering. (source lines 1206-1240)
